IMD Warns of Heavy Rainfall in Kerala Tomorrow, Yellow Alert in Nine Districts
The India Meteorological Department has warned that heavy rains are likely to continue in Kerala tomorrow. Yellow Alert has been issued in nine of the 14 districts, forecasting isolated heavy rainfall. Seven districts are under Yellow Alert today. There is also a warning of the possibility of sea incursion along the coastal areas of Thiruvananthapuram district.
